verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Deployments as containers-as-a-service for running container images and serving ML models, which moves away from managing always-on instances. Nothing in the evidence shows autoscaling or scale-to-zero, and machine auto-shutdown after inactivity is a VM stop feature, not serverless scaling. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling of GPU workers, scale-to-zero behavior, per-request/serverless billing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
